name: Training the Beast
summary: In Teldrassil, Training the Beast sends night elf hunters from the wilds to Darnassus. After taming beasts among the boughs, they learn pet care and discipline from Jocaste.

sections.title: A Hunter's Rite of Passage
sections.body: Dazalar sends you from the wilds near Dolanaar to Darnassus once you prove you can tame a beast. Before you travel Kalimdor with a loyal companion, you need to learn more than how to use a taming rod. Subduing a wild creature tests your strength and will, but an untrained beast can still be unpredictable.

sections.title: Guidance in the Cenarion Enclave
sections.body: Jocaste teaches you the arts of caring for a companion in Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave. She shows you how to feed your pet, bring it back if tragedy strikes, and train it to fight. For night elves, this bond reflects reverence for nature, not simple control.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: what does training the beast do
faq.answer: You go to Darnassus to learn the skills needed to care for and train a lasting animal companion. This completes the first steps of a night elf hunter's training with a pet.
Jocaste is in Darnassus, in the Cenarion Enclave among the trees and hunter lodges in the northwest of the city.
Dazalar, the hunter trainer in Dolanaar, sends you after you've completed all three taming trials across Teldrassil.

faq.q: What skills do you learn from Jocaste?
faq.answer: Jocaste teaches you to feed your companion, revive it if it falls in combat, and train it in new abilities.

faq.q: Why does night elf culture emphasize pet training?
faq.answer: Night elf hunters treat their pets as partners, not tools to command. Their care reflects a belief in living with respect for nature.

faq.q: Is this quest available to other races?
aliases: can horde do training the beast
faq.answer: This journey to Darnassus is for night elf hunters. Hunters of other races undergo similar training with mentors of their own race.

angles.text: As a hunter, you learn to train, feed, and revive your companion as you move beyond the novice's path.
As a night elf, you share a tradition of companionship with beasts built on respect and coexistence, taught in Darnassus and the Cenarion Enclave.
